desc:
💤 YOUR HEROES EARN COINS OFFLINE! 💰

How to play:
🎲 Roll for +200 Heroes, from Common to SECRET!
🧬 Hunt rare MUTATIONS: Golden, Toxic, Spectral, Glitch, Rainbow and MORE!
🏛️ Place your best heroes on your podiums to earn coins every second
⬆️ Level up your heroes and grow your Class Tree
📜 Rebirth to multiply your coins forever and unlock stronger Summon Scrolls
🗼 Climb the Tower and defeat its bosses for gems and loot
⚔️ Battle in the PvP Arena and win weekly season rewards
🛡️ Join a Guild and fight for the weekly top

👥 Get +10% luck for every friend in your server (up to +50%)!
🎁 Join the group and favorite the game for a FREE REWARD!
🎟️ Redeem CODES in the Store!

👍 Like the game to support new updates!
